approved_minimal_definition_context.name: multivariateGaussian
approved_minimal_definition_context.meaning: Actual standard Gaussian pushforward by mean plus covariance square-root CLM. On-domain positive covariance is necessary; non-PSD Dirac fallback is not the source target and must be excluded internally.
approved_minimal_definition_context.exact_excerpt:
/-- Multivariate Gaussian measure on `EuclideanSpace ℝ ι` with mean `μ` and covariance
matrix `S`. This only makes sense when `S` is positive semidefinite,
as then `CFC.sqrt S * CFC.sqrt S = S`. Otherwise `CFC.sqrt S = 0`, and
`multivariateGaussian μ S = Measure.dirac μ` (see `multivariateGaussian_of_not_posSemidef`). -/
noncomputable
def multivariateGaussian (μ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (S : Matrix ι ι ℝ) :
    Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :=
  (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).map (fun x ↦ μ + toEuclideanCLM (𝕜 := ℝ) (CFC.sqrt S) x)

approved_minimal_definition_context.name: ProbabilityMeasure
approved_minimal_definition_context.meaning: Actual subtype of measures with total mass one, coerced to its underlying Measure. Rho is an arbitrary common probability output distribution, never a supplied desired bound or Gaussian certificate.
approved_minimal_definition_context.exact_excerpt:
/-- Probability measures are defined as the subtype of measures that have the property of being
probability measures (i.e., their total mass is one). -/
def ProbabilityMeasure (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] : Type _ :=
  { μ : Measure Ω // IsProbabilityMeasure μ }

namespace ProbabilityMeasure

variable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]

instance [Inhabited Ω] : Inhabited (ProbabilityMeasure Ω) :=
  ⟨⟨Measure.dirac default, Measure.dirac.isProbabilityMeasure⟩⟩

/-- Coercion from `MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω` to `MeasureTheory.Measure Ω`. -/
@[coe]
def toMeasure : ProbabilityMeasure Ω → Measure Ω := Subtype.val

/-- A probability measure can be interpreted as a measure. -/
instance : Coe (ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) := { coe := toMeasure }

standard_notation_context.Matrix_inverse: Actual square Matrix inverse, not entrywise inverse. Off-invertible totalization is not a source-domain hypothesis; proper on-domain inverse/covariance facts must be proved internally.
standard_notation_context.Fin_coordinate: Fin d zero coordinate is <0,hd> using the supplied d>=1 proof; scalar absolute value of its actual Euclidean WithLp.ofLp coordinate.
standard_notation_context.Measure_real: Real actual event mass obtained by ENNReal.toReal. All used Gaussian and common rho measures are probability measures on the ordinary Euclidean Borel space.
standard_notation_context.local_Delta: Literal real supremum of absolute real mass differences over all measurable events, with no factor2. The type asserts only its displayed probability-law instances; it does not certify a general TV formula on arbitrary infinite measures.
